name: Standing arm raise
description: Both arms are raised out to the sides and lowered. Demonstration configuration for software testing.
instructions: Stand facing the screen with your arms relaxed at your sides.
Raise both arms out to the sides as far as your therapist has asked.
Lower your arms back to your sides in a controlled way.

camera.guidance: Face the camera. Stand far enough back that your hips and both hands stay in view with arms raised.

messages.target_not_reached: Raise your arms a little higher.

form_rules.message: Keep your elbows fairly straight as you raise your arms.

setup: Stand facing the screen, far enough back that your hands and feet stay in view with arms overhead.
Feet hip-width apart, arms relaxed by your sides, palms facing your thighs.

cues.move: Lift both arms out to the sides toward the green line, elbows straight.
cues.back: Lower both arms slowly back to your sides.

key_points: Lift both arms together, at the same speed.
Stay upright; avoid leaning to the side to reach higher.
guidance.tempo: About 2 seconds up and 2 seconds down.

clinical_review.note: Thresholds and dosage are illustrative values for software testing, not clinical targets.
